data.body: Final implementation and debug report: Gerrit 1871 merged as e9969f8aecae6295251996db8a6bdd24a574cfc4. Problem: MCP transition_ticket and claim_ticket lacked parity for force, caused_by, and ref. Root cause: the MCP write schemas and forwarding layer omitted those supported engine parameters. Proof: focused facade and contract tests exercised the real MCP adapter and persisted ticket state. Fix: exposed and forwarded the parameters while preserving close_class validation and the distinct still-unsupported close-reason behavior. Base CI incident: run 32201527582 failed on an aggregate wall-time assertion; tapestried-abhorrent-tuna / Gerrit 1876 fixed that independent defect and merged before the rebase. New-main oracle incident: run 32206680534 deterministically failed because four strict MCP xfails and the force-claim convergence guard still encoded the old gap; PS5 removed only those stale markers and made the guard exercise the real MCP adapter. Test evidence: initial oracle RED 26 passed / 5 failed / 1 expected xfail; corrected GREEN 31 passed / 1 expected close-reason xfail; exact stale-xfail mutation returned RED with strict XPASS plus convergence-guard failure; restored focused gates 87 passed / 1 expected xfail; make lint passed. Final CI_RESULT: {run_id: 32209279331, status: passed, fixes_applied: [base watchdog test fix via Gerrit 1876, parity-oracle convergence update], retry_count: 0}. Gerrit gates: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments. Scope and safety: no new dependency; no production behavior was weakened; the oracle retains the unsupported reason row as strict xfail. Siblings: all contract rows across library, CLI, and MCP were exercised; no additional missing force/caused_by/ref surface remained. Replication: the original MCP parity cases and all CI platforms pass on the merged change.
